item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from email.parser import BytesParser
from email.policy import default
out=Path.home()/'emails.bak'
files=sorted(out.glob('inbox_*.eml'))
print('count', len(files))
for p in files:
    msg=BytesParser(policy=default).parsebytes(p.read_bytes())
    print(p.name, '| subject:', msg.get('subject'), '| from:', msg.get('from'))
PY"
